summary: Founder of the S. D. Warren paper company (Westbrook, ME); John's 6th cousin 6x removed via Hammond.
bio: Path: Lt. John Hammond → Abigail Hastings → Abigail Hastings (m. John Warren) → Samuel Warren (1704) → Joseph (1745) → John (m. Susanna Grout) → S. D. Children (all 7C5R): Samuel D. Warren II (1852–1910), co-author with Louis Brandeis of 'The Right to Privacy' (1890); Edward Perry Warren (1860–1928), art collector (the Warren Cup), who commissioned Rodin's The Kiss (Lewes version); Henry Clarke Warren (1854–1899), Pali/Buddhism scholar (Buddhism in Translations); Fiske Warren, single-tax utopian; Cornelia Warren, philanthropist.
